title: Low-Tier Magic Crystal
text: A spell crystal stores its target, shape, elements, modifiers and authored base cost. Its keywords reflect the components used.
Right-click to cast once and consume the crystal. Alternatively, install it in an equipped crystal grid and cast repeatedly with a staff, consuming mana instead.
While exploring ruins and vanilla loot chests, you may also find low-tier magic crystals with spells already inscribed, ready to use or install in a grid.
